newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IDT Corp cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IDT Corp cut to neutral.

text.p: -- First Albany Corp said it downgraded IDT Corp to neutral. The previous rating was not immediately available.
-- said the company's announcement that it was cutting jobs is a step in the right direction.
-- said the best move for IDT is to move out of the Internet business and focus on its telecom business.
-- said if IDT keeps its Internet business, it would be forced to maintain and upgrade the costly infrastructure. These upgrades would continue to restrict earnings.
-- said it downgraded the stock pending further developments towards refocusing the company.
